title: China's wholesale inflation tops estimates in August on commodity costs, tech demand as consumer price increases meet forecast
summary: China's wholesale inflation exceeded forecasts in August, driven primarily by rising commodity costs and favorable base-effect comparisons rather than genuine consumer demand growth.
content: Much of the anticipated pickup reflects a favorable base-effect comparison and higher commodity costs, rather than a genuine strengthening in household demand.
